neighbours.label: Quantized atomic energy: discrete energy levels, electrons jumping between them, spectral lines
fire: In the Bohr model the orbits are quantized.
An atom absorbs light only at certain energy levels.
Emission lines appear where electrons drop between levels.
The Balmer series is a set of lines in the hydrogen spectrum.
The vibrational energy of a molecule is quantized.
Each spectral line matches a jump between two states.
Electrons jump between shells and emit a photon.
The energy levels of the hydrogen atom are discrete.
quiet: In the Ptolemaic model the orbits are circular.
A plant absorbs light mostly in its green leaves.
Bus lines appear where riders transfer between routes.
The Beatles catalog is a set of songs in the British charts.
The kinetic energy of a car is large.
Each railway line matches a route between two towns.
Children jump between ropes and throw a ball.
The water levels of the lake are low.

predictions: Quantum-level wording fires; the same words (lines, levels, energy, jump) in everyday senses stay quiet.
